title: 语法 · 介词｜搭配与动名词 · 60 句
description: 动词、形容词、名词的介词搭配，介词后动名词、复合介词与不应多加介词的动词。

items.zh: 请向登记员咨询门禁卡的领取办法。
items.en: Consult the registrar about collecting your access card.
answers: Consult the registrar about collecting your access card.
items.notes: consult 直接接人；about 引出咨询主题。

items.zh: 我没有把照片附在信上，而是另行发送了。
items.en: I sent the photograph separately instead of attaching it to the letter.
answers: I sent the photograph separately instead of attaching it to the letter.
items.notes: attach A to B；instead of 后接动名词。

items.zh: 这个结论依赖于尚未核实的目击描述。
items.en: The conclusion rests on eyewitness accounts that remain unverified.
answers: The conclusion rests on eyewitness accounts that remain unverified.
items.notes: rest on：以……为依据；不要误用 rest at。

items.zh: 我们向邻居借了一个能折叠的推车。
items.en: We borrowed a folding trolley from our neighbour.
answers: We borrowed a folding trolley from our neighbour.
items.notes: borrow A from B，区别 lend A to B。

items.zh: 经理把不满归因于排班不透明。
items.en: The manager attributed the dissatisfaction to unclear scheduling.
answers: The manager attributed the dissatisfaction to unclear scheduling.
items.notes: attribute A to B：将 A 归因于 B。

items.zh: 这项服务为独居者提供定期联系。
items.en: The service provides people living alone with regular contact.
answers: The service provides people living alone with regular contact.
items.notes: provide someone with something；对象与内容不可颠倒。

items.zh: 我不想让孩子因为口音而被嘲笑。
items.en: I do not want children to be laughed at for their accents.
answers: I do not want children to be laughed at for their accents.
I don't want children to be laughed at for their accents.
items.notes: laugh at 被动时保留 at；for 表原因。

items.zh: 他们劝我不要在拥挤时段搬运钢琴。
items.en: They advised me against moving the piano at a busy time.
answers: They advised me against moving the piano at a busy time.
items.notes: advise someone against doing：劝某人不要做。

items.zh: 请把误送来的信转交给楼下住户。
items.en: Please pass the misdelivered letter on to the downstairs resident.
answers: Please pass the misdelivered letter on to the downstairs resident.
items.notes: pass something on to someone：转交；to 标接收者。

items.zh: 志愿者把毯子分发给了正在等候的乘客。
items.en: Volunteers distributed blankets to the waiting passengers.
answers: Volunteers distributed blankets to the waiting passengers.
items.notes: distribute A to B；waiting 修饰接收者。

items.zh: 这个斜坡不适合轮椅独立通行。
items.en: The slope is unsuitable for independent wheelchair access.
answers: The slope is unsuitable for independent wheelchair access.
items.notes: unsuitable for 后接用途或对象。

items.zh: 他对新成员的提问一直很有耐心。
items.en: He is consistently patient with newcomers' questions.
answers: He is consistently patient with newcomers' questions.
items.notes: patient with：对……有耐心；不使用 patient to。

items.zh: 我对这份工作的时间要求已有充分了解。
items.en: I am fully aware of the time demands of this role.
answers: I am fully aware of the time demands of this role.
items.notes: aware of 后接所知内容；of 与 aware 搭配。

items.zh: 屋顶上的太阳能板很容易受到冰雹损害。
items.en: The rooftop panels are vulnerable to hail damage.
answers: The rooftop panels are vulnerable to hail damage.
items.notes: vulnerable to 中 to 是介词，后接名词。

items.zh: 这份结果与我们原先的估算一致。
items.en: The result is consistent with our original estimate.
answers: The result is consistent with our original estimate.
items.notes: consistent with：与……一致。

items.zh: 该程序与较旧的操作系统不兼容。
items.en: The program is incompatible with older operating systems.
answers: The program is incompatible with older operating systems.
items.notes: compatible 或 incompatible 均搭配 with。

items.zh: 她负责的是内容审核，而不是资金审批。
items.en: She is responsible for content review, not funding approval.
answers: She is responsible for content review, not funding approval.
items.notes: responsible for + 职责内容，不能省略 for。

items.zh: 新入口可以让行动不便的人使用。
items.en: The new entrance is accessible to people with limited mobility.
answers: The new entrance is accessible to people with limited mobility.
items.notes: accessible to 标可使用的人；with 描述个人情况。

items.zh: 我不愿意接受没有说明原因的更改。
items.en: I am reluctant to accept unexplained alterations.
answers: I am reluctant to accept unexplained alterations.
items.notes: reluctant 后是不定式 to accept，此 to 不同于介词 to。

items.zh: 目前没有任何方案能完全免受风险影响。
items.en: No available option is entirely free from risk.
answers: No available option is entirely free from risk.
items.notes: free from 表免于不良因素；entirely 限定程度。

items.zh: 夜间噪声的增加引起了住户的关注。
items.en: An increase in night-time noise has drawn residents' attention.
answers: An increase in night-time noise has drawn residents' attention.
items.notes: increase in + 发生变化的指标；不把 in 写为 of。

items.zh: 屋顶损坏的原因尚不明确。
items.en: The cause of the roof damage remains unclear.
answers: The cause of the roof damage remains unclear.
items.notes: cause of 接结果；原因自身不是 because of 的从句。

items.zh: 学生缺少参加国际交流的机会。
items.en: Students lack opportunities for international exchange.
answers: Students lack opportunities for international exchange.
items.notes: opportunities for + 名词；也可用 opportunity to do。

items.zh: 这个方案与实际需求之间存在明显差距。
items.en: There is a clear gap between the proposal and actual needs.
answers: There is a clear gap between the proposal and actual needs.
items.notes: gap between A and B 描述二者差距。

items.zh: 公众对公告的反应比预期更平静。
items.en: The public response to the announcement was calmer than expected.
answers: The public response to the announcement was calmer than expected.
items.notes: response to：对……的回应；to 为介词。

items.zh: 设备更换带来的收益尚未超过成本。
items.en: The benefits of replacing the equipment have not yet outweighed the cost.
answers: The benefits of replacing the equipment have not yet outweighed the cost.
The benefits of replacing the equipment haven't yet outweighed the cost.
items.notes: benefits of doing：某行为带来的收益。

items.zh: 团队对外部顾问的依赖正在减少。
items.en: The team's reliance on external advisers is decreasing.
answers: The team's reliance on external advisers is decreasing.
items.notes: reliance on：对……的依赖，与 rely on 对应。

items.zh: 费用的分配方式引发了双方的争议。
items.en: The allocation of costs caused a dispute between the two parties.
answers: The allocation of costs caused a dispute between the two parties.
items.notes: allocation of：……的分配；between 标双方关系。

items.zh: 我们需要解释异常数据，而不只是删除它们。
items.en: We need an explanation for the unusual figures, not merely their removal.
answers: We need an explanation for the unusual figures, not merely their removal.
items.notes: explanation for：对某现象的解释。

items.zh: 放宽标准不应成为忽视质量的借口。
items.en: Flexible standards should not become an excuse for neglecting quality.
answers: Flexible standards should not become an excuse for neglecting quality.
Flexible standards shouldn't become an excuse for neglecting quality.
items.notes: excuse for doing：做某事的借口。

items.zh: 她通过画示意图解释了水流方向。
items.en: She explained the direction of flow by drawing a diagram.
answers: She explained the direction of flow by drawing a diagram.
items.notes: by doing 表手段，不能写 by draw。

items.zh: 我很期待与你一起查看这些手稿。
items.en: I look forward to examining the manuscripts with you.
answers: I look forward to examining the manuscripts with you.
items.notes: look forward to 中 to 为介词，后用 examining。

items.zh: 我们反对在没有说明的情况下更改规则。
items.en: We object to changing the rules without an explanation.
answers: We object to changing the rules without an explanation.
items.notes: object to doing：反对做；不是 object to change。

items.zh: 他们坚持亲自查看损坏的部件。
items.en: They insisted on inspecting the damaged components themselves.
answers: They insisted on inspecting the damaged components themselves.
items.notes: insist on doing；themselves 强调亲自。

items.zh: 我为没有及时归还测量仪器道歉。
items.en: I apologise for not returning the measuring instrument promptly.
answers: I apologise for not returning the measuring instrument promptly.
items.notes: for 后用 not doing，否定放动名词前。

items.zh: 除了清点库存，她还核查了标签。
items.en: Besides counting the stock, she checked the labels.
answers: Besides counting the stock, she checked the labels.
items.notes: besides doing：除做此事之外还做其他事。

items.zh: 你能阻止这些信息被自动删除吗？
items.en: Can you prevent the information from being deleted automatically?
answers: Can you prevent the information from being deleted automatically?
items.notes: prevent ... from being done：阻止某物被处理。

items.zh: 我们没有通过添加装饰来解决版面问题。
items.en: We did not solve the layout problem by adding decoration.
answers: We did not solve the layout problem by adding decoration.
We didn't solve the layout problem by adding decoration.
items.notes: by doing 表方式；否定针对这种解决方式。

items.zh: 在决定接受之前，我想核对付款条件。
items.en: Before agreeing to accept, I want to check the payment terms.
answers: Before agreeing to accept, I want to check the payment terms.
items.notes: before 后接 agreeing；agree to accept 中 to 是不定式标记。

items.zh: 他离开时没有取走自己的行李。
items.en: He left without collecting his luggage.
answers: He left without collecting his luggage.
items.notes: without doing：没有做某事便……；luggage 不可数。

items.zh: 这批座椅是根据观众反馈重新设计的。
items.en: These seats were redesigned in response to audience feedback.
answers: These seats were redesigned in response to audience feedback.
items.notes: in response to：为回应；to 后接名词。

items.zh: 货物由铁路运送，而不是由公路运送。
items.en: The goods travel by rail rather than by road.
answers: The goods travel by rail rather than by road.
items.notes: by + 交通方式通常不加冠词。

items.zh: 仓库暂时关闭，以便检查屋顶。
items.en: The warehouse is closed for the purpose of inspecting the roof.
answers: The warehouse is closed for the purpose of inspecting the roof.
items.notes: for the purpose of doing：为了做某事。

items.zh: 他以个人身份出席，而非代表所在机构。
items.en: He attended in a personal capacity rather than on behalf of his institution.
answers: He attended in a personal capacity rather than on behalf of his institution.
items.notes: in a ... capacity 表身份；on behalf of 表代表。

items.zh: 这些措施是针对反馈采取的，并非随机变化。
items.en: The measures were taken in light of the feedback, not at random.
answers: The measures were taken in light of the feedback, not at random.
items.notes: in light of：考虑到；at random：随机地。

items.zh: 无论天气如何，室内展览都会照常进行。
items.en: The indoor exhibition will proceed regardless of the weather.
answers: The indoor exhibition will proceed regardless of the weather.
items.notes: regardless of + 名词，不直接接完整陈述句。

items.zh: 根据目前掌握的资料，尚无法确认来源。
items.en: On the basis of the available information, the source cannot be confirmed.
answers: On the basis of the available information, the source cannot be confirmed.
On the basis of the available information, the source can't be confirmed.
items.notes: on the basis of：根据……。

items.zh: 这笔款项应只用于培训相关费用。
items.en: The payment should cover expenses in connection with training only.
answers: The payment should cover expenses in connection with training only.
items.notes: in connection with：与……有关。

items.zh: 与常见印象相反，这个地区的冬天相当温和。
items.en: Contrary to the common impression, winters in this region are fairly mild.
answers: Contrary to the common impression, winters in this region are fairly mild.
items.notes: contrary to + 名词，表示与某说法相反。

items.zh: 这套设备目前正由技术人员检查。
items.en: The equipment is currently under inspection by technicians.
answers: The equipment is currently under inspection by technicians.
items.notes: under inspection 表处于检查状态；by 标执行者。

items.zh: 我们讨论了安全问题，没有马上作出决定。
items.en: We discussed safety concerns without reaching an immediate decision.
answers: We discussed safety concerns without reaching an immediate decision.
items.notes: discuss 直接接宾语，不加 about。

items.zh: 所有新生都必须参加入学说明会。
items.en: All new students must attend the induction session.
answers: All new students must attend the induction session.
items.notes: attend 表参加活动时直接接宾语，不加 to。

items.zh: 我联系了管理员，询问丢失的包裹。
items.en: I contacted the caretaker about the missing parcel.
answers: I contacted the caretaker about the missing parcel.
items.notes: contact 直接接人；about 接联系主题。

items.zh: 请回答屏幕上的问题，不必回复这封邮件。
items.en: Answer the question on screen; there is no need to reply to this email.
answers: Answer the question on screen; there is no need to reply to this email.
items.notes: answer 直接接对象，reply 必须搭配 to。

items.zh: 不能仅根据价格把这两种材料相比较。
items.en: The two materials cannot be compared solely on price.
answers: The two materials cannot be compared solely on price.
The two materials can't be compared solely on price.
items.notes: compare on + 比较维度；solely 限定单一依据。

items.zh: 她向我们解释了故障，但没有解释为什么没有提前通知。
items.en: She explained the fault to us but not the lack of advance notice.
answers: She explained the fault to us but not the lack of advance notice.
items.notes: explain something to someone，不能写 explain us something。

items.zh: 我提醒他检查电池，并没有警告他会失败。
items.en: I reminded him to check the battery; I did not warn him of failure.
answers: I reminded him to check the battery; I did not warn him of failure.
I reminded him to check the battery; I didn't warn him of failure.
items.notes: remind someone to do 与 warn someone of something 使用不同补足结构。

items.zh: 我更喜欢步行，而不是等一班不确定何时来的车。
items.en: I prefer walking to waiting for an unpredictable bus.
answers: I prefer walking to waiting for an unpredictable bus.
items.notes: prefer doing to doing；to 是比较介词，后接动名词。

items.zh: 这个数据集包括匿名回答，但不包含联系方式。
items.en: The dataset comprises anonymous responses but excludes contact details.
answers: The dataset comprises anonymous responses but excludes contact details.
items.notes: comprise 为及物动词，此处不写 comprise of。

items.zh: 尽管缺少说明书，他们还是把零件正确装好了。
items.en: Despite the missing manual, they assembled the parts correctly.
answers: Despite the missing manual, they assembled the parts correctly.
items.notes: despite 后接名词短语，不能写 despite of。
